name: guition-jc1060p470-bsp
description: Board support for the Guition JC1060P470C-I-W-Y (ESP32-P4): JD9165 1024x600 MIPI-DSI panel (manual bring-up, no esp_lcd_jd9165 vendor component) + GT911 I2C touch. Double-buffered framebuffer, no rotation (glass is natively landscape).
keywords: esp32-p4, esp32p4, jd9165, mipi-dsi, gt911, guition, jc1060p470, bsp, lcd, touch
